record.question: Fever in hemodialysis patient with a catheter and no local signs should raise suspicion of:
record.explanation: Answer C: Catheter-related bloodstream infection. In a hemodialysis patient with an intravascular catheter and unexplained fever, catheter-related bloodstream infection should be considered even without visible local inflammation. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/infection-control/hcp/intravascular-catheter-related-infections/summary-recommendations.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
